status: FROZEN LIST for the maintainer's P1t grant: the application's 59 tasks, re-drawn by P1's rule and matched to its id hashes; nothing is generated without a grant naming this plan's launch identity

protocol.same_as: P1's launch identity :: generation_protocol (byte for byte)

establishes.R0_provenance: every item names a registered, trainable source and carries the fields its kind needs
establishes.R1_held_out_keys: no item shares a prompt or content key with a held-out unit
establishes.R2_near_duplicate: no item is a 13-gram near-copy of a held-out prompt
establishes.R3_rule_family: no item comes from a rule family a fluid evaluation item uses
establishes.R4_eval_only_generators: no item comes from an evaluation-only generator or its task type
establishes.R5_shared_generator_exposure: shared-generator items are calibration-split families in the training seed range
establishes.R6_source_split: every dataset item comes from a trainable split
establishes.R7_arc_agi: no ARC-lineage source or module, and no item carrying ARC-AGI-1 grids
establishes.R9_mechanism_equivalence: no item comes from a project family whose rule computes an evaluation family's rule

isolation_R0_R9._: prompts only; P1v reruns R0-R9 with the teacher text

seed_rule: pass k runs run_battery with --seed-base <plan base> + k; a turn's seed is request_seed(base, task_id, turn), so every candidate and turn has its own recorded seed

totals._predicted: the application's measured tokens per task x its tasks: a PREDICTION, not a limit

on_short_corpus: if the accepted units still do not build B on the formal ladder, the gap is reported and P1t stops there: no automatic further paid top-up, no lower gate, no repetition, no other source or mix (maintainer 2026-10-23)
_reading: the comp/Reasoning Gym forecast rests on a few easy groups (largest_island L0 7/7, tower_of_hanoi L0 6/6, string_manipulation L0 2/7; 11 of 14 module-levels yielded 0): a prediction, not a promise
